277069231.description:
Zippo Pipe Lighters
Lot of 2 Lighters, Black Matte and Brushed Chrome
Made in USA, 2012 and 2014
This lot features two authentic Zippo pipe lighters, specifically designed for pipe smokers with a specialized chimney insert that allows the flame to be drawn directly into the pipe bowl without damaging it. Both lighters are marked with a pipe silhouette on the front corner and were manufactured in Bradford, Pennsylvania. These lighters are highly functional collectibles known for their durability and windproof design.
Items Included:
Black Matte Zippo Pipe Lighter - Date code K 12 (November 2012), featuring a white pipe graphic and specialized chimney insert.
Brushed Chrome Zippo Pipe Lighter - Date code J 14 (October 2014), featuring a black pipe graphic and specialized chimney insert.
Dimensions: Approximately 1.5 inches length, 1 inch width, 2.5 inches height per lighter.
Condition:
Both lighters show signs of previous use including internal carbon buildup and soot in the chimneys. The black matte finish has light surface scuffing and minor wear along the edges. The brushed chrome finish shows typical pocket wear with fine hairline scratches. Hinges are secure and snap shut. Wicks are present but used; flint and fuel status has not been tested.
